description: Support routines for creating and handling custom pack files, including functions for pack headers, pack objects, and trailers, as well as utility functions for binary and octal representations, and some test routines for pack object identifiers.

methods.name: uint32_octal
methods.description: Prints the big-endian 4-byte octal representation of a number.

methods.name: uint32_binary
methods.description: Prints the big-endian 4-byte binary representation of a number.

methods.name: pack_header
methods.description: Prints the pack header for version 2 with specified number of objects.

methods.name: pack_obj
methods.description: Outputs the pack data for an object, potentially as a delta or full object, with hardcoded cases for well-known objects.

methods.name: pack_trailer
methods.description: Computes and appends pack trailer to a specified file.

methods.name: clear_packs
methods.description: Removes existing pack files to ensure subsequent use of newly generated packs.
